summary: A 34-year-old Boulder man fell 25-30 feet while climbing at the Animal World rock formation in Boulder Canyon; he was unconscious when rescuers arrived; technical litter evacuation to the roadway and Med Evac flight to a Denver-area hospital with serious injuries.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Boulder County Emergency Services, Nederland Police, USFS, Nederland Fire, Rocky Mountain Rescue, AMR, CDOT, North Colorado Med Evac
